purpose: The exact integration environment for study execution through Petri: every version a run must resolve to. Built and tested 2026-09-16 in a Python 3.12 virtual environment; CI installs from this file and refuses to run when the resolved environment differs (docs/petri_integration_design.md section 11).

harness.name: inspect_petri
harness.note: hatch-vcs derives the version string from git and the fork carries no tag, so the string does not identify the commit; the commit field is the identity. The fork's own uv.lock pins anthropic 0.97.0 and openai 2.30.0, below Inspect's provider floors; the pins of record below replace them for study execution without any change to the fork.

offline_tests.suite: inspect_petri tests/ at the pinned commit, offline (no keys, no network), run against the packages above
offline_tests.command: python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --no-header  (pytest-xdist workers per the fork's pyproject)

failures.reason: The sandbox runs as root, so pytest's temporary directory is /tmp/pytest-of-root/...; the test asserts the string 'root' is absent from a grep result that contains that path. Unrelated to the SDK versions; passes wherever the temp path does not contain 'root'.

deviations: tiktoken's o200k_base encoding download is blocked by the sandbox egress proxy (HTTP 403); a scratch-only conftest.py stubbed tiktoken.get_encoding and tiktoken.encoding_for_model with a character-count encoder for this run. The stub is not part of the lock and must not be needed in CI, where the download is allowed.

verification_rule: CI installs exactly `packages` (pip with ==), checks out the harness at `harness.commit`, recomputes lock_sha256 over this file minus that field, and compares python.version, every package version and the harness commit of the resolved environment to this file; any difference refuses the run before a model call. The run manifest records harness.environment_lock_sha256.
sha256_rule: sha256 of json.dumps(lock without lock_sha256, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False) encoded as UTF-8
